load_dataset_metadata: load dataset metadata from a package path returning a DatasetMetadata dataclass with description, citation, and tags
get_valid_tags: get a list of valid dataset tags from the tfds core valid_tags.txt file
get_valid_tags_with_comments: get valid dataset tags as a newline-separated string with comments stripped
read_metadata_files: read all metadata files (CITATIONS.bib, README.md, TAGS.txt) from a dataset package directory
parse_tags_from_text: parse a list of tags from raw tag text content ignoring comments and blank lines
